notes:
Slice: confirmed Path customers (Valmont, Millerbernd, Nello). 
RELATIONSHIP CALLS TO REVIEW: p-millerbernd-winsted-mn and p-nello-south-bend-in are marked known_customer with tag inferred (only pole-making site of the parent; no source names the Path site). Downgrade to customer_other_plant if you want the strict reading. All Valmont plants are customer_other_plant (2021 reference, no plant named). Nello passed Path FAT only.
VALMONT COVERAGE GAP: valmont.com/valmontstructures.com locations widgets do not list steel pole plants (they list Site Pro 1, Ingal, Locker, Irrigation Components, towers, etc.). 10-K Item 2 lists only principal plants and states, not a per-plant list. Plant set built from job postings (address-bearing), state/10-K, TxDOT list and news. Likely missing Valmont US pole sites not seen in postings; Valmont Utility imports ~$220M of fabricated steel structures from Monterrey Mexico (not US, out). Street addresses for Claremore (25010 Alliance Dr) and Jasper (1950 Industrial Blvd) came from search-result text only, so the address field is 'unknown' while lat/lon use those streets for geocoding (see geocode_note).
Excluded Valmont rows are for concrete (Tuscaloosa AL, Bristol IN), galvanizing (Midland PA), composite (Newberry SC), tower plants (Salem OR, Plymouth IN) and the Valley NE irrigation campus (Valley may also make poles; unverified). Valmont Farmington MN kept as base, aluminum-first.
